- Whole-field view showing widespread, uniform yellowing across the entire canopy
- Plants at late growth stage (R6-R7), still with leaves attached
- No obvious patches of dead/wilted plants (rules out Phytophthora, Charcoal_Rot)
- No white mold/sclerotia visible
- No stem-level lesions visible at this scale

**Reference comparison summary:**
- **SDS whole_plant**: Scattered yellow plants in mostly green field — less uniform than test
- **SCN whole_plant**: Mostly green with some lower leaf yellowing — doesn't match
- **Charcoal_Rot whole_plant**: Wilted dead plants — doesn't match
- **Phytophthora whole_plant**: Discrete dead patches in green field — doesn't match
- **Green_stem_disorder whole_plant**: Completely dry/brown with isolated green stems — doesn't match
- **Fusarium whole_plant**: Mostly green — doesn't match
- **Soybean_rust whole_plant**: Mostly green — doesn't match
- **Septoria_brown_spot leaf**: Yellow leaves with small dark lesions — consistent with widespread field yellowing at distance

The test image shows the kind of uniform whole-field yellowing most consistent with **Septoria_brown_spot**, which causes widespread lower/mid-canopy defoliation and yellowing at late season. The leaf reference confirmed progressive yellowing with dark lesions, which at a field scale produces exactly the uniform yellow-green appearance seen here.
